report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified. Current traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200/ok with no errors. Order metrics show only 200s on /v1/orders (v1.0.0) and no 502s; deployment record shows only baseline v1.0.0 with no prior version, so no deployment-caused fault is established. Healthy telemetry contradicts the hypothesis; logs were excluded. Handing off for error evidence.
missing_evidence: Traces/logs showing actual checkout errors (non-2xx or error results); current traces show only 200/ok.
Error-rate metrics by route/status for checkout and order over the incident window.
Deployment records for the checkout service and any version change preceding the alert.
Logs (ev-...-order_logs) were excluded/unavailable; needed to confirm or refute error presence.
